properties.label: Korba · Cap Bon
properties.description: A coastal agricultural window around Korba, where groundwater used for irrigation is exposed to seawater intrusion.

evidence.title: Vulnerability of a Tunisian Coastal Aquifer to Seawater Intrusion
evidence.limitation: Aquifer-scale vulnerability modelling. The study does not give current salinity, pumping rates or water rights for this map window.

source.name: NASA POWER daily
source.coverage: MERRA-2 and SYN1DEG gridded data for the requested point. UTC complete-day means for temperature and irradiance, precipitation summed over the same days.

location_source.name: Study-window reference point
location_source.coverage: Reference point for an approximately 10 × 10 km evidence window. The window is not a cadastral or study-area boundary.
